verdicts.reason: A uses a proper left-to-right banner flow (headline, phone, CTA) with good legibility, but the legal line hangs far below the CTA with a large gap and isn't aligned to the button's edges, and the headline sits lower than the CTA, so the composition loses its rhythm. B keeps the portrait stacking: the headline wraps to three lines in a wide format, the CTA nearly touches the bottom edge, the legal text is jammed against the button, the phone nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and the middle of the canvas is a large dead area, so it looks crammed and lopsided.
